title: Notification Service Kafka Consumer Lag Rebalance Stall
symptoms: Kafka consumer lag spiked to 250,000 messages on notification.email topic
Consumer group entering continuous rebalance loops
No prior Kafka rebalance incidents recorded in database
observations: Worker threads blocked on downstream SMS gateway
verification: Consumer group stabilized, lag cleared from 250k to 0 in 12 minutes
root_cause: Downstream SMS partner endpoint latency exceeded max.poll.interval.ms, triggering Kafka consumer heartbeat timeouts and rebalance loop.
resolution: Increased max.poll.interval.ms from 60s to 300s and offloaded SMS dispatch to async background thread pool.
